AI Briefing · Saturday, October 31, 2026

Today in 30 seconds

  • Anthropic's S-1 numbers need checking. Transformer reports $16.3B of H1 2026 revenue, up 14x, against an $80.7B net loss. Neither figure has yet been matched to the filing. 1
  • OpenAI's raise reportedly falls short. Techmeme reports about $11B in commitments against a $30B target, with valuation reportedly trimmed from $1.4T to $1.25T. OpenAI is still raising. 2
  • Neoclouds reportedly lose bond access. WSJ reports lenders shut out CoreWeave, Nebius and Nscale by demanding tougher terms. Nvidia may cosign Nscale's West Virginia loan, unconfirmed. 3
  • Big Tech borrows to build. S&P says the big five raised $326B of debt in 2026, triple last year. Alphabet, Amazon and Meta ran negative free cash flow, and S&P cut Meta's outlook. 4
  • Mistral opens a 1T model, with a catch. Large 4 (about 49B active) is free to self-host internally. Selling it as a service needs a commercial license, and the benchmarks are Mistral's own. 5

A question worth asking in diligence this week: how exposed are a startup's compute supply and pricing to a neocloud that cannot refinance?
